headline: Keyboard and mouse controls and difficulty presets arrive as mods
summary: OpenRAC's Keyboard and Mouse mod reaches 1.1.1 and Difficulty reaches 1.1.0, adding configurable controls and visible difficulty presets. SDK 1.3.0 supplies mouse-pointer input, while the editor gains a Collision dock for level and object edits. Up Your Arsenal's PAL v1.00 matched code rises from 8.38% to 8.72%, and Deadlocked's NTSC-U v1.00 rises from 4.03% to 4.41%. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Ratchet & Clank and Going Commando also record smaller gains on their primary releases.
